profile.name: Your Company
profile.summary: A team running multiple products and customer-facing surfaces at once, with work spread across engineering, support, and go-to-market.

agents.mandate: Own the roster: assign every incoming task to exactly one agent and keep the shared context current.
Read every inbound ticket, resolve the routine ones, and escalate the rest with a written summary.
Take scoped tickets to a reviewed pull request, with tests, without touching anyone else's branch.
Profile inbound leads before a human ever opens the thread, and write the brief into the CRM.
Turn every shipped change into public documentation and a changelog entry within the same day.
Watch error rates and latency, open the incident, and hand a timeline to whoever is on call.
